Q: Is there any feasible solution to read WOT battle results .dat files? A:

might or might not work at wot, y'all need to use the wot scripts to unpack the results, if not it's gonna be unnecessarily hard. They are on the internet somewhere. Look for battle_results.py, in there the function showFromCache. A bit of debugging and you'll find what everything means. Remember though, every time you launch the client, they get deleted, so you need to deny delete permissions to the folder from windows.

Q: Change checkout page in WooCommerce A:

You can avoid the custom code approach entirely by using a plugin like Acowebs WooCommerce Checkout Field Editor. It lets you add, remove, reorder, and customize checkout fields with a drag-and-drop interface - no coding needed. There's a free version on the WordPress repo too.

Q: How do I get the local system time in PHP? A:

PHP's time will return the system time. You can format it with date

If you just want to display the time in the local time of the visitor maybe you're better off using a little javascript
